summary: Two Bedroom Apartment · City Centre · Top Floor
description:
Acorn Properties are delighted to offer for rent this stunning top floor apartment on St. Mary's Place. Situated next to Northumbria University, the property is suitable for both professionals and students alike with excellent access to the city centre. Having undergone a recent refurbishment, the apartment comprises of; entrance hallway, open plan lounge kitchen with dinning area, private roof terrace, two double bedrooms and large bathroom.

Available from 13/08/2022, priced at £1100 PCM. Call Acorn Properties today to arrange a viewing.
